comments.author: Misun
comments.body:
"I tried before by me, having the skills and my friend having the fame."

Derp. I just said you can't leech fame. You can't leech fame. Get it? You can't leech fame. For any quest.

If your friend had the fame, your friend would have to pull the quest, and try to leech your skills. For most quests it'll work eventually, usually with a lot more QMP than if the person pulling had all the reqs. Job quests... a lot of them won't work unless you have every req, including languages.
